title: Fazbear Catalog
description: Welcome to the Fazbear Entertainment Catalog! This mod is made to add plenty of blocks and decor for whatever FNaF themed build you make!
body:
**Welcome to the Fazbear Entertainment Catalog!**

This mod is made to add plenty of blocks and decor for whatever FNaF themed build you make!
Adding a ton of Floortiles, Walls, Ceilings, and Decor!

Soon to have over 500+ blocks, Tons of plushies, and even a fully built in shop for survival players!

Please Note: This mod is in early BETA and the stuff I want added aren't in the mod quite yet.

Do you want get sneakpeeks, give suggestions and feedback, and talk to other people who downloaded the mod? Well I have a brand new discord server for you!

[https://discord.gg/B5ARMVbU2T](https://discord.gg/B5ARMVbU2T)
